implementation.change: Build canonical edit programs sequentially and fail immediately before appending the first program whose addition would exceed MAX_CONTEXT_BYTES.
implementation.semantic_reason: Shared patch length is monotone and MAX_CONTEXT_BYTES is already a hard representation invariant. Once the next program crosses the cap, later work cannot restore validity.
implementation.accepted_semantics: Canonical member order, edit-program construction, offsets, compressed contexts and physical bytes are intended unchanged for accepted containers.
implementation.rejected_semantics: Same ValueError class/message, earlier only after the first irreversible cap crossing.

kill: any early rejection before the first irreversible patch-budget crossing
claim_boundary: Research implementation only. No r25 grammar, selector, admission, product, release or external-frontier credit.
